chapter: Chicago memories and the road to the Navy
title: Two years at the Lyric Theater among the vaudeville acts
summary: Zutty played the Lyric about two years, knowing Ethel Waters, Bessie Smith, Bruce's grocery store tab show, Butter Beans and Susie, and a dancer compared to Bojangles.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Oh the Cadillac, that was, I told you......
That's where you were with Louis Russel.
Robicheaux, old man Robicheaux stood outside and listened to me play.
Took you to the Lyric? Now how long were you at the Lyric?
Oh gee, about two years I guess, think because I knew Ethel Waters and Bessie Smith and Bruce and his grocery store.
What was that, a comedy thing?
Yes a comedy thing. Sort of tab show you know.
Yes. Hard Tack Jackson, Butter Beans and Suzie.
Yes. and he was a hell of a dancer.
Oh yes. They used to say they could compare him with Bo Jangles you know.
